title: Artificial Intelligence-Based Diagnosis of Gastric Mesenchymal Tumors Using Digital Endosonography Image Analysis
summary: Clinical/endoscopic factors improved random-forest and KNN discrimination of GIST versus non-GIST, with AUCs 0.896 and 0.825. Retrospective, single-center, 387 analyzed resection cases with histopathologic labels and 10-fold cross-validation; selection bias toward surgically resected tumors and lack of independent external validation are explicit limitations.
ai_technology: Logistic regression, decision tree, random forest, KNN, and SVM classifiers use digital EUS image features; combined models add age and tumor location.
